goal: Validate v3 vocabulary and policy YAML without mutating generated files.
when_to_use: Use before generation, before PR, and when reviewing v3 policy-only changes.
commands: go run ./cmd/cervorules-policygen check -vocab policy-vocabulary.yaml -policy policy-rules.yaml -format json
failure_mode: Fail the task if the check command returns non-zero or emits invalid JSON.
notes: Use JSON output when another agent or CI step consumes the result.
